Record Class FloatingLinearLayout<T>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.mcalgovisualizations.layouts.FloatingLinearLayout<T>
Record Components:
spacing - distance in blocks between consecutive elements (must be > 0)
yOffset - vertical offset added to origin.y()
zOffset - depth offset added to origin.z()
All Implemented Interfaces:
ILayout<List<T>>
public record FloatingLinearLayout<T>(double spacing, double yOffset, double zOffset) extends Record implements ILayout<List<T>>
A ILayout implementation that arranges elements in a straight horizontal line along the positive X-axis.

All elements share a constant Y-coordinate ("floating"), meaning their vertical position does not depend on the element value.

Elements are spaced evenly using the configured spacing.
